personal_candidate.title: Machine-linked nonpass learning verdicts
personal_candidate.target_job: prevent measured nonpass results from bypassing bounded feedback and proposal follow-up
personal_candidate.mechanism: Require every machine-readable result inventory and make each nonpass identify existing feedback plus at least one proposal that links that feedback.

source_evidence.original_failure: A published nonpass could remain disconnected from the active feedback and proposal state, and later omission of the inventory disabled validation.
source_evidence.before: Removing the learning verdict inventory bypassed the cross-file learning check.
source_evidence.after: Missing inventories and disconnected nonpass links fail deterministic validation.
source_evidence.gate_decision: The independent Gate accepted Coach v4 after the v3 linkage mechanism.
source_evidence.live_cycle: Product and release negative controls both rejected an omitted inventory.
source_evidence.known_limitation: The mechanism validates linkage; it does not judge proposal quality or invent feedback.

personal_candidate.primary_metric: Published nonpass verdicts without valid feedback and proposal links remain at zero.
guardrails: passing verdicts need no invented failure
personal_candidate.disable_condition: Revoke or narrow after one unlinked nonpass passes, a passing-only run is forced into evolution, or private evidence is required.

transfer_preregistration.claim: The accepted nonpass-linkage invariant transfers to machine-readable evaluation results across distinct local project shapes.
transfer_preregistration.primary_metric: Published nonpass verdicts without valid feedback and proposal links remain at zero.
guardrails: passing verdicts need no invented failure
transfer_preregistration.falsification_condition: Any positive shape accepts a missing or disconnected link, the passing-only shape activates, or broader permissions are required.
